h1: Scale Regional Operations Across Singapore with Autonomous AI
sub: Deploy dedicated AI agents on isolated 24/7 cloud computers to automate regional trade research, coding, and cross-platform workflows effortlessly.
audience: Regional headquarters, FinTech firms, cross-border e-commerce operators, family offices, and tech startups managing ASEAN operations from Singapore.
manifesto: In Singapore's relentless regional hub, productivity isn't just an edge—it is survival. Ceyo deploys persistent autonomous cloud agents that research, code, and execute round-the-clock while you orchestrate global business from Marina Bay or Changi.

uses.d: Monitor freight updates across PSA terminals and regional ports, parsing shipping manifests and updating supply chain sheets in real time.
Deploy autonomous browsers to extract pricing, regulatory changes, and tender opportunities across Southeast Asian markets into unified reports.
Cross-check corporate filings, regulatory disclosures, and corporate registries automatically using cloud browsers and shared team memory.
Track competing SKUs, update multi-currency catalogs, and automate customer message routing across regional online marketplaces.
Collate macro indicators, currency movements, and regional equity earnings before your morning transit into Raffles Place.
Instruct your coding agent to scaffold web microservices, test APIs, and push builds directly inside an isolated cloud sandbox.

steps.d: Spin up an isolated 24/7 cloud environment with your personal AI bot ready instantly.
Link Telegram, Google Sheets, Notion, CRMs, and over 1,000 workplace applications seamlessly.
Assign multi-step research routines, web scraping, or coding tasks via voice calls or Telegram.

chapters.d: While riding the Downtown Line toward the CBD, your Telegram bot delivers a synthesized breakdown of overnight ASEAN market movements and priority customer emails. Actionable items are already drafted and waiting for your tap.

Over lunch near Telok Ayer, your agent uses its autonomous browser to scan regional competitor portals, benchmark logistics rates, and compile the findings into Google Sheets. No manual tab-hopping required.

Your coding agent writes, runs, and tests a webhook connector inside its isolated cloud computer before deploying the update. Your Telegram team channel receives the verified GitHub link automatically.
As the city turns in, your scheduled routines continuously track global supply chain updates, prepare tomorrow's schedule, and balance tasks in shared memory. Your phone stays silent and offline.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost, and how does the free trial work?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three plans: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked card is charged only when the trial concludes unless cancelled prior.

faq.q: Do Ceyo bots keep working if my laptop is closed or phone is off?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo bot operates on its own dedicated, isolated cloud computer that runs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, independently executing scheduled tasks and workflows regardless of your device's power state.

faq.q: Can multiple AI bots collaborate together in Telegram group chats?
faq.a: Absolutely. You can add several specialist bots into a single Telegram group chat, allowing your researcher, coder, and operations bots to coordinate actions, share context, and execute composite tasks as an automated unit.

faq.q: What languages and data environments can Ceyo handle?
faq.a: Ceyo seamlessly processes English, Mandarin, Malay, Tamil, and dozens of other international languages, allowing your agents to interact with multilingual websites, cross-border documentation, and localized web portals across Asia.

faq.q: Can Ceyo browse websites, run code, and execute transactions?
faq.a: Yes. Every bot features an autonomous web browser to navigate web portals and compare data, a built-in coding sandbox to test and host applications, and a native crypto wallet for automated web transactions.
